notes.title: Portuguese (Brazil) Is Added to the Game!
notes.content:
How to Sing to Open Your Heart Remastered now supports Portuguese (Brazil).
The game now supports 7 languages and voiced in Japanese.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593431/ba0734f0ec69c0916b18e8396434fcb2b70ab796.jpg[/img]

Thank you very much to Rance Guertena who has translated the game :)
Enjoy! ːkuronekoː ːmyanaː ːludovicː

notes.title: How to Sing to Open Your Heart Remastered now supports Turkish!
notes.content:
How to Sing to Open Your Heart Remastered now supports Turkish as its 6th supported language!
Thank you very much for the translator ÖBÖ & RBÖ who provides the translation for the whole Eroolia series. They especially told me that the Ludo-something translation would be funny 🤔 Enjoy!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593431/1a9b7670ec5f966f6a0f850f3080420ca5fcba8c.jpg[/img]

Don't forget that you can change the language at any time from the Options menu!

notes.title: Update Notes February 1, 2023
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Now player can proceed the game with Space bar.
[*] Input Field issue fix: The "OK" button will be selected if player inputted the letter "S" in input field (such as name) because of the primary Unity ADWS setting. This has been fixed now.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes For July 25th 2022 (2)
notes.content:
Sorry for the second update within the same day.
This update is to fix the screen tearing/ vsync issue on Full Screen Mode.
Let me know if you get any other issue!

notes.title: Update Notes For July 25th, 2022
notes.content:
The game is updated to settle the opening-video-not-play issue on Linux OS.
Windows version and Mac version are also updated to match the Linux files, but the change is only within the opening video codec.

The demo version is also getting the similar update, but besides the issue above, it will also settle the weirdly appear "trial version" mark on the right down side of the screen.
